XBOW_API_KEY.description: XBOW API key. Minted via XBOW partner console. Sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'. Normally pre-configured on the dispatcher as a varenv — leave blank in the Run form to use the agent-side value.

XBOW_API_URL.description: XBOW API base URL. Default 'https://api.xbow.com'. Override for private-cloud deployments.

XBOW_MODE.description: Comma-separated list of what to import. Default 'findings'. Valid: findings (agent-discovered vulns -> vulns), engagements (assessment runs summarised), assets (registered assets -> hosts).

XBOW_FINDINGS_PATH.description: Path (with leading slash) for the findings endpoint. Default '/v1/findings'. Override if XBOW's real endpoint differs (docs not fully public at time of writing).

XBOW_ENGAGEMENTS_PATH.description: Path for the engagements endpoint. Default '/v1/engagements'.

XBOW_ASSETS_PATH.description: Path for the assets endpoint. Default '/v1/assets'.

XBOW_MAX_PAGES.description: Hard cap on pages fetched per mode. Default 50 (= 5k rows at the default page size).

XBOW_MIN_SEVERITY.description: Client-side severity floor for findings. Valid: info | low | medium | high | critical. Default 'medium'.

name: xbow
title: XBOW
description: XBOW autonomous AI-pentester import. Bearer API key against XBOW's public API (default https://api.xbow.com/v1/). Modes: findings (agent-discovered vulns become Faraday vulns tagged '[AGENT]' on the affected asset, with PoC + remediation folded into the description and CVE/CWE cross-refs), engagements (assessment runs summarised as info-level records), assets (registered assets become Faraday hosts tagged 'agent:xbow:asset-inventory'). Endpoint paths are configurable per install (XBOW_FINDINGS_PATH / _ENGAGEMENTS_PATH / _ASSETS_PATH) because XBOW's public API docs weren't complete at write time. Severity is normalised into Faraday's info/low/medium/high/critical scheme; XBOW_MIN_SEVERITY drops rows below the floor. External IDs are stable so re-runs are idempotent. Cursor + page-based pagination; backs off 30s on HTTP 429.
